Most likely this Mesa bug - https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/mesa/mesa/-/issues/5699.

> Godot Project Manager on Debian starts OK.
> Godot Editor crashes.

Project Manager always use OpenGL. Editor is using whatever you have selected in the project settings (Vulkan by default).

Duplicate of #82435 and the above linked Mesa bug indeed.

Sadly the only solution is to either restrict yourself to using the GL Compatibility renderer, or upgrade Mesa to a newer version than the one Debian provides.

hm. you may be right since with Compatibility different Bug appears. and crashes with different signal, 11. (SIGSEG)
